document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The shopkeeper, a short man, is somehow familiar. He has a huge 
collection of phony artifacts and cheap pottery. In fact, there is a 
suspect air about this place. You can browse for an hour. If you 
succeed with a Spot Hidden roll, go to 191; if you fail the roll, 
return to the market at 134.
(134)
